screenshots.notes: Distinct solid/dashed setup cards and baseline value. All three choices fit side by side; the selected answer and primary check buttons are easy to identify. Numeric entry is unclipped and the hidden comparison stays hidden.
Numbered sections give prediction, calculation and results clear separation. Worked equation and current/hypothetical result bars are readable; primary and secondary actions remain distinct.
Stacked choices, setup cards and full-width actions fit the narrow panel. Pale text, amber primary actions and the selected border are distinct; long help text wraps without overlapping controls.
Selected answer, numbered headings, controls and solid/striped comparison bars remain distinguishable. The long equation wraps within its card; no horizontal content is cut off.
